scripts.generate:calendar: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -c "from datetime import date; from app.services.asr_labs_planner import generate_asr_labs_calendar, calendar_to_markdown; from app.services.calendar_store import save_calendar; c=generate_asr_labs_calendar(start=date.today()); p=save_calendar(c); p.with_suffix('.md').write_text(calendar_to_markdown(c), encoding='utf-8'); print(p)"
